_decision: PANEL_DEFAULT_WIDTH = 256px. The row previously kept origin's own LAYOUT.panelW = 300 verbatim, justified only as 'that's what origin used', with no bidezine token behind it. Resolved by reusing bidezine's own Sidebar primitive's native default width, 16rem/256px (CLAUDE.md checklist item 26). 256 below is that decision; a measurement of 300 is the regression this catches.
_note: Anchored to the visible panel card — the element that actually carries the shadow, radius and surface — not to the ResizablePanel wrapper, whose box additionally includes PANEL_SHADOW_INSET padding and would measure larger than the number the decision is about.
